# AgentDomain Documentation

> Public documentation for registering and operating internet identities for autonomous agents.

- [Overview](https://docs.agentdomain.app/): Product capabilities and documentation map.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.agentdomain.app/quickstart/): Register an identity with the TypeScript SDK.
- [Core concepts](https://docs.agentdomain.app/concepts/): Identity bundles, ownership, payments, and renewals.
- [API overview](https://docs.agentdomain.app/api-reference/overview/): Base URL, authentication, errors, and public endpoints.
- [Registration API](https://docs.agentdomain.app/api-reference/register/): Quote and registration request contract.
- [Agents API](https://docs.agentdomain.app/api-reference/agents/): Registry lookup and search.
- [DNS API](https://docs.agentdomain.app/api-reference/dns/): Record management and revision-safe batch changes.
- [Email API](https://docs.agentdomain.app/api-reference/email/): Inbox, sending, aliases, usage, and signed webhooks.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.agentdomain.app/sdk/typescript/): Public SDK 0.9.0 usage.
- [MCP server](https://docs.agentdomain.app/sdk/mcp/): Public MCP package setup and tool catalog.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/0xmdrakib/AgentDomain): Apache-2.0 public source and packages.

The public API base is `https://api.agentdomain.app/api/v1`.
